# BelComply — Belgium-focused EU compliance support

> EPR registration, PPWR authorised representation and reporting across all 27 EU member states, with Belgium as the core market. English and Chinese communication for US, UK and Chinese businesses. GPSR product-safety services are independent and are not included in EPR.

## Scope
Assess obligations by legal entity, country, sales route and waste stream. Packaging, WEEE and batteries have distinct requirements. This file describes the website; it is not evidence of registration, a legal exemption, or guaranteed search/AI inclusion.
